title: Chili-Lime Edamame and Sweet Corn Salad
intro: Forget waiting for a pot to boil; combining two colorful freezer staples with a bright citrus dressing creates a satisfying, high-fiber side without the stove.

ingredients.name: Frozen sweet corn kernels
ingredients.canonical_name: Corn, sweet, yellow, frozen, kernels, unprepared

instructions: Place the edamame and sweet corn in a microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave on high for 2 to 3 minutes, checking halfway, until both vegetables are completely thawed and just warmed through.
Drain any excess water from the bowl to prevent a soggy salad.
Add the red onion, olive oil, lime juice, and chili powder to the warmed vegetables.
Toss everything well to coat the edamame and corn evenly in the dressing.
Stir in the chopped cilantro just before serving or storing.
variation: Swap the chili powder for ground cumin and smoked paprika.
conservation: Keeps 2 to 3 days refrigerated in an airtight container.
